description: H4. `unlimited` means this level adds no constraint, never that no constraint exists. Ada writes it for payroll and is capped at the department's 800.00 — finite by induction, and narrower than the word reads.

requests.note: An ordinary counterparty: the declared 600.00 applies.
The exception resolves to min(1000.00, 800.00) = 800.00. Writing one word did not reach 1000.00 and did not reach past the company threshold either.
